notes: EZVIZ is Hikvision's consumer brand (launched 2013). Most AC-powered EZVIZ cameras with wired/Wi-Fi LAN support local RTSP via port 554; RTSP is disabled by default and must be enabled in the EZVIZ mobile app (Settings > Local Network > Third-party access or equivalent). Authentication uses username 'admin' and the device's 6-character uppercase verification code printed on the label (NOT the EZVIZ cloud account password). Battery-powered models (BC series) and most video doorbells (DB series) do NOT support local RTSP and stream exclusively via EZVIZ cloud. The Hikvision ISAPI paths /Streaming/Channels/101 (main) and /Streaming/Channels/102 (sub) reportedly work on many EZVIZ models due to shared firmware but are not published in EZVIZ's own support documentation. The officially documented paths are the /ch1/main and /ch1/sub family.
